traditional: A hard contact. Love, money, and pleasure works against growth, fortune, and patronage - obstruction, friction, and strained outcomes in these areas. Two benefics: among the easiest contacts, though it can incline to excess.
modern: Pleasure meets expansion. Gentleness, generosity, sensitivity, and a great deal of ease. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Play-before-work and indulgence undercut accomplishment. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.meaning: Connection and growth reach full awareness and face each other: culmination, objectivity, fulfillment or confrontation.

business: Friction in this area. Likable and fortunate; the missing ingredient is discipline.
shadow: Indulgence and vanity collides with excess and overreach; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: A confrontation builds; the other side comes fully into view.
arcSeparating: The standoff resolves into balance or a split.
base: Generosity stops feeling generous when the yes is easy in the moment and the cost keeps arriving later.

readerCopy.body: Generosity stops feeling generous when the yes is easy in the moment and the cost keeps arriving later. When Venus opposes Jupiter, the desire to give, include, spend, celebrate, or make someone happy expands beyond the amount anyone actually meant to offer. Goodwill can be sincere while creating resentment when one person repeatedly absorbs the extra cost. Giving is easier to sustain when the amount shared belongs to the present resources rather than to the wish that nobody be disappointed.
